```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Purpose.** Orientation for the two-study drought-queue package. The numbered
R scripts in `steps/` are the executable sequence; this document is the map.

| Step | Stage | Study |
|---|---|---|
| 00 | setup and readiness | both |
| 01 | gauge profiling | India |
| 02 | inventory → fit → meta | India |
| 03 | power / MDE | India |
| 04 | one-factor sensitivity grid | India |
| 05 | figures | India |
| 06 | Caravan screening | USA |
| 07 | ResOpsUS ↔ Caravan match | USA |
| 08 | county + USDM target | USA |
| 09 | reservoir rates and queue | USA |
| 10 | paired evaluation | USA |
| 11 | manuscript figures | both |
| 12 | verification battery | both |

```{r}
need <- c("output/selected_gauges.csv", "output/meta_endpoints.csv",
          "output_us/reservoir_queue_meta.csv", "output_us/us_meta.csv")
for (f in need) {
  cat(sprintf("%-45s %s\n", f, if (file.exists(file.path(QDJ_ROOT, f))) "ok" else "MISSING"))
}
```

`[measurement]` The package contains two independent tests. India: 24 gauges,
11 basins. USA: 50 core reservoir–catchment pairs, 21 paired for the
confirmatory contrast. The shared result is a calibrated-probability null with a
small ranking gain.
